description: Karnataka to table AI University Bill in winter session, aiming to create a dedicated AI education hub. The proposed legislation will establish a new university with a permanent campus planned in Bengaluru. The move follows discussions with industry leaders like Kris Gopalakrishnan to drive AI research and innovation.
body_lead: Karnataka govt to table AI University Bill in winter session The government is looking to acquire around 100 acres in Bengaluru for the permanent campus. A view of Vidhana Soudha.
